script_text: Aries, this week the cosmos drops a bombshell you won't see coming. Your ruling planet Mars squares Neptune in your 10th House early Monday, clouding career moves and salary negotiations — delay signing contracts until Wednesday. Tuesday brings Mercury retrograde tension in your 7th House of partnerships, stirring hidden conflicts with loved ones. The turning point hits Thursday when Jupiter trines your Aries Sun, lifting restrictions and expanding your professional horizons overnight. Love blooms Friday as Venus sextiles Pluto in your 5th House, igniting passion in existing relationships or attracting exciting new connections. Weekend energy favors bold social moves — your natural Aries fire draws admirers like moths to flame. Wednesday is your worst day due to Mars-Neptune confusion, while Saturday shines as your power day when Jupiter's expansive trine supercharges your ambitions. Take one decisive career step this week and trust your instincts. Follow for daily updates.
